name: Hanno Renner
profile: German entrepreneur who co-founded HR-software company Personio in Munich in 2015 with fellow CDTM classmates. Personio grew into one of Europe's most valuable startups (valued ~$8B in 2022), serving SMEs with HR and payroll software; Renner continues to lead it as CEO.
interesting_fact: Personio started with about $200 in the bank and reached a $6.3B valuation within six years, making Renner one of Europe's youngest unicorn CEOs.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Personio he trained as a sailing skipper and spent semester breaks taking tourists out on sailing boats; he studied industrial engineering at HTWG Konstanz and Management & Technology at TUM.
notes: Press releases also list press@personio.de; best route is Personio's comms team.
